To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

in the context of digital transformation, the competitiveness of enterprises is determined by the ability of management to make effective management decisions based on the use of decision support tools in conditions of structural transformations of the economy.

the proposed algorithm for working with a decision support tool in the process of managing competitiveness, which was developed and implemented as part of this research, allows to solve a number of tasks of competitiveness analysis and management, which is a necessary condition to ensure the effective functioning of enterprises and the competitiveness of the economy as a whole.

the competitiveness management system is a set of methods, tools and techniques that allow to increase the competitiveness of an enterprise, which includes: the development and implementation of a system of indicators and criteria for measuring the level of competitiveness; the formation of a system of recommendations and measures to improve the competitiveness; a system of tools to support decision making and management.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of the impact of the digital economy on the competitiveness of enterprises in the conditions of structural changes in the economy.

the development of a methodological basis for the development and application in practice of information support for the decision-making tools of the competitiveness management system of enterprises, which is aimed at the development of the competitiveness of enterprises in the conditions of structural changes in the economy and digitalization of economic activity.
developing and implementing a methodology for building a system for providing information support for decision-making tools for improving the competitiveness of enterprises.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the development of the information system of the decision support tools for improving the competitiveness of enterprises is a promising direction for research.

the development of decision support systems and tools in the process of competitiveness management is an effective way of increasing the competitiveness of enterprises in the conditions of structural changes in the economy and digitalization of business processes.

the development and use of information support tools for decision-making in the management of competitiveness of enterprises, based on BigData technologies and predictive modeling, is a necessary condition for increasing the competitiveness of enterprises in the context of structural changes in the economy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed approach is a new way of using decision-making support tools in the process of competitiveness management, based on the use of BigData technology and the use of a set of mathematical methods of data analysis and forecasting.

it is necessary to take into account the specifics of the enterprise in order to improve its competitiveness, to develop and implement a system for supporting management decisions and competitiveness management, and to use BigData technology for the collection and processing of information about the enterprise and the market environment.

we have developed an information system for decision support in the competitiveness management system of the enterprise, the use of which makes it possible to increase the competitiveness of enterprises and the effectiveness of the competitiveness management system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of decision support tools in conditions of structural and technological changes of the economy is possible only with the use of BigData technologies.

the development of the system for decision support in the management of enterprise competitiveness is possible on the basis of the application of modern methods of information processing, analysis and modeling of data, as well as the application of BigData technology.

the development of a system of decision support in the management of competitiveness should be based on the development of a methodology for the use of information support in the process of decision-making and the formation of recommendations for decision-makers.
